name: Veracode Identity API
description:
Veracode Identity API Documentation

Use one of the following base URLs depending on the region for your account:
* https://api.veracode.com/api/authn - Veracode US Region (default)
* https://api.veracode.eu/api/authn  - Veracode European Region
* https://api.veracode.us/api/authn  - Veracode US Federal Region

For well-known end points use one of the following URLs depending on the region for your account:
* https://api.veracode.com - Veracode US Region (default)
* https://api.veracode.eu - Veracode European Region
* https://api.veracode.us  - Veracode US Federal Region
